thought: Okay, daily challenges with a photo. My daughter sent this. I'm new, so I'll press Start.
It says pick up to 3. I'd like to get fitter, so I'll start with Fitness and gym.
Fitness is checked now. I walk most mornings, so I'll add Health too.
Fitness and Health are both checked and it says 2 of 3 picked. Two is enough for me, so I'll press Continue.
So I take a photo of each task, or just tick it if nobody can check. Get them all done and the day counts, and my streak goes up. Simple enough. Continue.
Three choices. I walk most mornings anyway, so 7,000 steps is the one I can actually do. It says self-reported, so no photo needed. I'll join that.
The 7K Steps button just says Joining. The phone may still be loading, so I'll give it a second before pressing anything else.
It skipped ahead to the steps task. I walked this morning, so I'll press Done to mark today finished.
confusion: I thought it would ask about reminders first, but it went straight here.

thought: A box popped up asking who sees this. Friends is already picked, and I don't have friends on here yet anyway, so I'll just press the big orange button to post it.

One day in a row, every task done. Good, that's the first task finished. I don't need to share it with anyone, so I'll press Done and see what comes next. The app still hasn't asked me to save an account.
Now it wants me to save the account, after the task like my daughter said. I'm not using Apple, so I'll press the email one.
It wants my email and a password to keep the challenge. I'll put the email in the top box first.
The email is in the top box now. Next I'll put my password in the box under it.
Both boxes are filled in now, the email and the password. The big orange Continue button should save it.
It's asking me to check the email. That's the right address, same as the one I was given. So I'll press Send it.
confusion: "Send it" — send what? I thought I was just saving my account.

thought: I'm back on the home screen. It says today is secured, 1 of 1 done, and my walk is checked off. The account got saved with the email, so I think I've done what my daughter wanted.
